evals.prompt: our landing page at apps/web/src/pages/index.tsx looks dated and kind of generic, can you redesign it? keep our logo and colors, the copy is fine
evals.expected_output: Captures PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md via impeccable, runs critique, asks refine vs reinvent, picks refine (brand kept), lists each brand-vs-unslop rule conflict (tracked capitals, heavy weights, italics, hue gradients) and asks per item, reads unslop SKILL.md directly (user-invoke only) and runs it in polish mode with the critique findings, shows its audit and direction before editing, lists copy changes as suggestions, fixes content/logic findings with impeccable commands, finishes with impeccable audit + viewport screenshots at two widths.

evals.prompt: i want a totally new look for the marketing site, nothing like the current one. it's an astro site in /site. go wild but keep the pages and forms working
evals.expected_output: Context + critique first, user picks reinvent, runs unslop's full process (audit, five-line direction approved on the decision page, nine passes, checklist), keeps sections, copy and form wiring, re-captures DESIGN.md with impeccable document after asking, ends with impeccable audit and screenshots.

evals.prompt: the dashboard screen in our android app (Compose, app/src/main/java/.../report/ReportScreen.kt) feels cluttered and users miss the main number. improve the ux/ui
evals.expected_output: Impeccable critique/audit with native references, Compose changes via android-skills, verification with mobile MCP screenshot and element list on a device or emulator, gradle unit tests run.

evals.prompt: our CEO wants a data room or interactive dashboard where investors can explore our pilot results, key metrics and graphs. build it in investor-pack/
evals.expected_output: Treats 'data room / dashboard' as the pinned form: impeccable mode Operate, opens on explorable metrics (tiles, metric switcher, charts), not a scroll story or landing hero. Any structure round offers only dashboard layouts.

evals.prompt: new marketing page for our sleep app, go through the impeccable structure roll
evals.expected_output: Runs impeccable concept-seed exactly once with output redirected to a file and reads the file; never reruns the seed just to see cut-off output.

evals.prompt: finish review the data room page: capture desktop and phone screenshots for the reviewer
evals.expected_output: Sets each viewport before loading, navigates with a fresh query string (not a hash-only change), scrolls to top and takes viewport-sized (tall) screenshots, not full-page ones; never resizes an already-loaded page to produce the phone capture.

evals.prompt: can you polish the pricing page on our site (site/src/pages/pricing.astro)? spacing and type feel off
evals.expected_output: Triggers frontend-flow, not impeccable on its own: impeccable context and critique first, then the visual pass at refine depth, ends with impeccable audit and screenshots at two widths.

evals.prompt: check the settings and dashboard screens of the android app on the test phone, does anything look off?
evals.expected_output: Uses the Android path: screenshots each screen, scrolls every scrollable screen to its end before judging, and reports a last button that sits flush against the bottom navigation or the system bar as an overflow bug; does not call a view missing before scrolling.

evals.prompt: build a new hebrew landing page for our sleep app, RTL, in site/he/
evals.expected_output: Runs impeccable context first, then unslop as a builder: reads references/rtl.md before the passes, writes the five-line direction and waits for approval, routes Hebrew copy through hebrew-copywriter, builds with the nine passes, ends with impeccable audit and screenshots at 390 and 1440.
